info.title: API-DocTest-Replace Auto Insurance Quotes Renew-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the renewal process for auto insurance quotes, allowing clients to efficiently manage their coverage options. By submitting the necessary details via the renewal endpoint, users can update their existing quotes based on any changes in their circumstances or preferences. Insurance agents and customers can leverage this service to ensure their policies are kept up-to-date with minimal effort. The API supports a seamless transition from existing quotes to the renewed terms, enhancing customer experience and satisfaction.

put.description: This operation allows users to renew an existing quote by submitting the necessary details. It is designed to facilitate seamless continuity of service and ensure customers have up-to-date pricing information.

requestBody.description: Request body for renewing a quote. This should contain the necessary details required for the renewal process, ensuring that the correct quote is targeted and the appropriate renewal parameters are provided.

200.description: Request completed successfully. The quote has been renewed.
